description: This file contains unit tests for the ReadingGoalCalculator class, verifying its methods for calculating reading progress, schedule adherence, and related date-based logic within a book tracking application.

classes.name: ReadingGoalCalculatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ReadingGoalCalculator utility methods related to reading progress and schedule calculations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes static mock for DateUtils before all tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes the static mock for DateUtils after all tests.

methods.name: calculateCorrectProgressValue
methods.description: Tests calculation of progress towards reading goal with typical values.

methods.name: calculateCorrectProgressValueWhenGoalMet
methods.description: Tests calculation when the reading goal has been exactly met.

methods.name: calculateCorrectProgressValueWhenGoalExceeded
methods.description: Tests calculation when the reading goal has been exceeded.

methods.name: testNoProgressMadeTowardsGoal
methods.description: Tests calculation when no books have been read.

methods.name: notAttemptToDivideByZeroInCalculateProgressTowardsReadingGoal
methods.description: Ensures the method returns zero instead of dividing by zero when toRead is zero.

methods.name: shouldNotThrowExceptionOnZeroDivision
methods.description: Verifies that the method handles zero read books gracefully without exceptions.

methods.name: setFirstWeek
methods.description: Mocks the current week number to 1 for testing schedule calculations at the start of the year.

methods.name: behindSchedule
methods.description: Tests schedule calculation when the user is behind at the start of the year.

methods.name: onSchedule
methods.description: Tests schedule calculation when the user is exactly on schedule at the start of the year.

methods.name: aheadOfSchedule
methods.description: Tests schedule calculation when the user is ahead at the start of the year.

methods.name: setWeekToMiddleOfYear
methods.description: Mocks the current week number to 26 for testing schedule calculations mid-year.

methods.name: behindSchedule
methods.description: Tests schedule calculation mid-year when behind.

methods.name: onSchedule
methods.description: Tests schedule calculation mid-year when on schedule.

methods.name: aheadOfSchedule
methods.description: Tests schedule calculation mid-year when ahead.

methods.name: setLastWeekOfYear
methods.description: Mocks the current week number to 52 for testing schedule calculations at year's end.

methods.name: behindSchedule
methods.description: Tests schedule calculation at year's end when behind.

methods.name: onSchedule
methods.description: Tests schedule calculation at year's end when on schedule.

methods.name: aheadOfSchedule
methods.description: Tests schedule calculation at year's end when ahead.

methods.name: testBooksToReadFromStartOfYear
methods.description: Verifies calculation of proportion of books to read from start of the year.

methods.name: returnFalseInBookHasFinishDateThisYearIfBookIsNull
methods.description: Checks that null book input returns false for finish date this year.

methods.name: returnFalseIfBookDoesNotHaveAFinishDate
methods.description: Checks that a book without a finish date returns false.

methods.name: createBook
methods.description: Helper method to create a Book object with default properties for testing.

methods.name: returnFalseIfBookNotReadThisYear
methods.description: Verifies that a book finished last year returns false for being read this year.

methods.name: returnTrueIfBookReadThisYear
methods.description: Verifies that a book finished this year returns true for being read this year.
